content.question: What is the main purpose of regularization in machine learning?
options: To prevent overfitting by penalizing large parameter values and simplifying the model.
To speed up model training by reducing the amount of training data.
To increase model complexity so it can memorize the training data better.
To convert an unsupervised problem into a supervised one.
content.answer: To prevent overfitting by penalizing large parameter values and simplifying the model.
